    StartersNeverland rainbow fruitMelon, kiwi, pineapple and blueberries in rainbow rows, lime and honey drizzleHow to make it1/4 watermelon1/4 rockmelon2 kiwifruits1/4 pineapple125g blueberries1 lime1 tbsp honeyCut the watermelon, rockmelon, kiwifruit and pineapple into chunks.Arrange in rainbow rows with the blueberries.Drizzle with lime juice mixed with honey.Tinkerbell fairy breadButtered white bread covered in hundreds and thousands, cut into trianglesHow to make it8 slices of white bread60g soft butter1/2 cup hundreds and thousandsedible glitter, to dustSpread the bread with butter right to the edges.Press face down into the hundreds and thousands and dust with edible glitter.Trim the crusts and cut into triangles.Rufio's rainbow dipsThe Lost Boys' feast and the food fight with RufioHow to make itAs written, serves 4Three bright dips, beetroot hummus, pea and mint, and carrot with cumin, swirled in bowls with warm pita chips for flicking at the table.Blitz 1 drained 400g tin chickpeas with 2 tbsp tahini, lemon, garlic and 3 tbsp oil, then split in two.Blend one half with 1 cooked beetroot.Blend 200g frozen peas, cooked, with mint, 50g feta and lemon.Boil 3 carrots until soft and blend with 1 tsp cumin, honey and oil.Cut 3 pitas into wedges, brush with oil and bake at 180°C for 8 minutes.MainsLost Boys roast chicken, potatoes and cornSpatchcock chicken with garlic, lemon and smoked paprika, potatoes, grilled cornHow to make it1.8kg whole chicken3 garlic cloves1 lemon2 tsp smoked paprika800g potatoes4 corn cobsSpatchcock the chicken and rub with crushed garlic, lemon zest and paprika. Chop the potatoes.Roast at 220°C with the potatoes in the tray.Grill the corn cobs, turning until charred.Pile it all in the middle and eat with your hands. Bangarang.Smee's Jolly Roger beef stewAboard the Jolly Roger with SmeeHow to make itAs written, serves 4Beef chuck braised three hours with smoky paprika, tomato, carrot and molasses until sticky and dark, served with cheesy ship's biscuit damper.Brown 1.2kg diced beef chuck in batches.Cook 2 onions and 2 carrots 5 minutes, add 2 tsp smoked paprika, 2 tbsp tomato paste, 1 tbsp molasses, 400g tinned tomatoes and 600ml beef stock.Cover and braise at 160°C for 3 hours.Rub 50g butter into 300g self-raising flour, add 80g cheddar and 200ml milk, shape into 8 rounds and bake at 200°C for 20 minutes.SweetsTick-tock crocodile cakePandan sponge with pandan buttercream and a chocolate clock face piped on topHow to make it4 eggs150g caster sugar150g self-raising flour210g butter1 tsp pandan extract300g icing sugar50g dark chocolateWhisk the eggs with the sugar until thick, then fold in the flour, 60g melted butter and half the pandan.Bake in a lined tin at 175°C.Cool the cake.Beat the remaining butter with the icing sugar and rest of the pandan, then cover the cake.Pipe a clock face with melted dark chocolate.DrinksPixie dust lemonadewith lime juice and a pinch of edible glitterHow to make it1.3 L lemonade1 lime1 pinch edible glitterPour the cold lemonade into a jug with the lime juice.Stir in the glitter and pour into four glasses straight away.Mango and passionfruit smoothiePeter's happy thought is his kids.
